answer: Each agent mints a unique sonnet‑coded credential stored at a blockchain vertex, its hash linked to a time‑locked relic of computational work. Peers periodically challenge one another; to answer they must reveal the pre‑image of the sonnet, costing a fixed bond that is slashed if the response mismatches the vertex record. An attacker must duplicate the costly work and stake for every fake identity, making a Sybil burst economically prohibitive.
